title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/fragment.rs undeclared variables in write_to functions (index in Fragment, n/body_bytes in Ack)
description: Fragment::write_to uses undeclared `index` at lines 154,155,156,160,161,162 in the 7+1 bit-packing loop. Ack::write_to uses undeclared `n` at line 251 and `body_bytes` at line 252. Both missing variable declarations. Pre-existing in parent commit f72b273558. Fix: need `let mut index = 0;` before the MIC byte loop in Fragment::write_to; need `n` computed from bitmap width and `body_bytes = n.div_ceil(8)` in Ack::write_to.
